adjudicated.jp: 桜庭に押し倒される夢を見た。
adjudicated.en: I dreamed of Sakuraba pushing himself on me.
adjudicated.assessment: 押し倒される says the narrator dreams of being pushed or pinned down. 'Pushing himself on me' adds the idiomatic implication of a sexual advance rather than reporting the physical action.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'I dreamed that Sakuraba pinned me down.'
